fusions.name: Pitch Too High
fusions.desc: Your hair thrums at a pitch too high to hear, dealing 4 resonating damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave its target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tethered Bite
fusions.desc: Sends a bat out on a strand to fasten on a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 28 dark damage that ignores resistance. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Rafter Line
fusions.desc: Throws a strand to a point up to 6 tiles away and snaps you there. You have 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Felt Before Seen
fusions.desc: At night, the fine hairs on your skin sense a blow coming: your dodge chance rises by 12%.
